cards.direction_or_boundary: At wavelengths up to 200 nm, the high-to-low composition endpoint ratio is very small and every complete scan decreases.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Whole-temperature scans, endpoint ratios, rank direction, and three predeclared wavelength cutoffs.
cards.object: Complete composition scans at each wavelength and effective temperature in the photon-flux grid.
cards.one_liner: Across all three temperature slices, the shortest supplied wavelengths show a strong decline in photon flux along the ordered composition axis.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A new complete temperature slice supports the boundary if its median high/low endpoint ratio at or below 200 nm is under 0.20 and at least 75% of scans decrease; either condition failing is failure.

cards.scope: A short-wave boundary in the supplied atmosphere calculations; it is not evidence for biological or evolutionary causation.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source reports joint temperature- and composition-dependent modulation of the short-wave stellar spectrum.
target_alignment.paper_location: Results and complete source-data atmosphere spectra.

cards.direction_or_boundary: All level pairs have strongly positive spectral correlation and their maxima span only a small wavelength interval.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Pairwise Pearson/Spearman shape comparisons, leave-one-level peaks, and intensity-weighted centroids.
cards.object: The complete five-column normalized spectral response table.
cards.one_liner: Five independent normalized response levels retain highly concordant spectral shapes and peaks within a narrow wavelength interval.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A new response level supports the relationship if its correlation with the retained consensus exceeds 0.90 and its peak lies within 20 nm of the retained peak basin; otherwise it fails.

cards.scope: Shape concordance in this independent representation; correlated levels are not five independent experiments.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source data show a recurring normalized spectral band across the supplied response levels.
target_alignment.paper_location: Independent normalized spectral series in the article-linked source data.

interpretation: These two cards are verified reference discoveries for blind-rediscovery diagnostics and are not an exhaustive answer set.
